question: A Playwright suite fails ~20% of the time on CI but passes locally. How do you systematically debug flakiness?
shortAnswer: Treat flakes as product bugs in tests: capture traces, eliminate timing assumptions, isolate shared state, and quarantine only temporarily.
strongAnswer: Collect CI artifacts (trace, video, network). Replace hard sleeps with expect polling/locator assertions. Ensure test data isolation (unique users, transactional resets). Check parallelism collisions and environment differences (viewport, CPU, feature flags). Fix root causes before increasing retries; retries hide defects.
advancedAnswer: Discuss deterministic seeding, contract tests reducing UI surface, and flake dashboards with ownership.
followUps: How do you test animations and toasts?
productionRelevance: Flaky suites erode trust and slow releases—common pain in automation-adopting BD teams.
